events.title: 30-Year Treasury Yield Hits 19-Year High
events.why_it_matters: A 19-year high in the 30-year Treasury yield signals persistent inflation expectations and/or concerns about fiscal deficits, which can raise borrowing costs across the economy, pressure equity valuations, and increase volatility in rate-sensitive sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Follow the 10-year yield, auction demand, Fed commentary, and any flight-to-safety flows. Watch for spillover into mortgage rates and corporate credit spreads.
sources: Web search: 30-year Treasury yield 19-year high August 18 2026

events.title: CFIUS Deal Review Activity
events.why_it_matters: CFIUS reviews can block or impose conditions on cross-border M&A, particularly involving foreign investment in sensitive US technologies. Heightened scrutiny can delay or kill deals, affecting specific companies and sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Announcements of new filings, public comments, and any completed or blocked deals. Monitor affected tickers and cross-border M&A sentiment.
sources: Web search: CFIUS deal review August 2026

events.title: Taiwan Strait Military Activity
events.why_it_matters: Increased military activity in the Taiwan Strait raises the risk of a major geopolitical flashpoint, threatening global supply chains, especially semiconductors, and causing risk-off sentiment in markets.
events.what_to_watch: Official statements from China, Taiwan, and the US; any naval or air incursions; market reaction in Asian indices, chip stocks, and safe-haven assets.
sources: Web search: Taiwan Strait military activity August 2026
